channel.title: Nubenetes Intelligence Digest
channel.description: AI-curated top picks from the Cloud Native & Kubernetes ecosystem

item.title: antigravity.google: Google Antigravity Agentic Platform
item.description: [CRITICAL] Provides a dedicated cloud native platform and SDK to bridge local stateful agent prototypes into scalable GKE production environments.

item.title: Crossplane
item.description: [CRITICAL] Transforms Kubernetes into a universal control plane capable of orchestrating multi-cloud infrastructure via declarative APIs.

item.title: buildkit
item.description: [CRITICAL] It is the foundational next-generation build engine driving high-performance, concurrent, and cache-efficient container image builds across the ecosystem.

item.title: github.com: Istio
item.description: [CRITICAL] Istio is the CNCF-graduated enterprise standard for service mesh, pioneering ambient mode and zero-trust microservice networking.

item.title: github: Flux Version 2
item.description: [CRITICAL] Flux v2 is a CNCF-graduated pillar of GitOps that powers decoupled, multi-tenant Kubernetes continuous reconciliation via the GitOps Toolkit.

item.title: github.com/prometheus/prometheus
item.description: [CRITICAL] Serves as the foundational CNCF metrics and monitoring engine powering telemetry across virtually all Kubernetes environments.

item.title: containerd - An open and reliable container runtime
item.description: [CRITICAL] It serves as the industry-standard, CNCF-graduated container runtime powering Kubernetes nodes across production cloud-native environments.

item.title: kubernetes-sigs/kueue: Kubernetes-native Job Queueing
item.description: [CRITICAL] Provides native batch job queueing and multi-tenant quota management critical for scaling AI/ML workloads on Kubernetes.

item.title: hashicorp/vault
item.description: [CRITICAL] HashiCorp Vault remains the cornerstone of enterprise secrets management, dynamic workload identity, and Zero Trust security architectures.

item.title: OpenTelemetry Collector
item.description: [CRITICAL] Acts as the vendor-agnostic industry standard pipeline for routing, filtering, and processing cloud-native telemetry across modern platforms.

item.title: github.com/vmware-tanzu/velero
item.description: [CRITICAL] It is the industry-standard cloud native disaster recovery and data protection tool for backing up Kubernetes state and persistent volumes.

item.title: trivy
item.description: [CRITICAL] Trivy is the ubiquitous standard for scanning container images, IaC definitions, and SBOMs for vulnerabilities across modern CI/CD pipelines.

item.title: Announcing Claude Managed Agents on Cloudflare
item.description: [CRITICAL] Establishes a sandboxed serverless execution plane at the edge to securely orchestrate autonomous agent workflows in production.

item.title: New in Terraform 1.15: Dynamic sources, variable deprecation, and more
item.description: [CRITICAL] Terraform 1.15 introduces native dynamic module sources, resolving a long-standing architectural constraint in enterprise infrastructure code reusability.

item.title: Argo CD
item.description: [CRITICAL] Argo CD represents the definitive industry standard for declarative, GitOps-driven continuous delivery on Kubernetes clusters.

item.title: crossplane.io
item.description: [CRITICAL] Crossplane leads the cloud-native infrastructure shift by turning Kubernetes into a universal, declarative control plane across multi-cloud environments.

item.title: podman
item.description: [CRITICAL] It leads the enterprise shift toward daemonless, rootless container execution, significantly improving host security and operational simplicity.

item.title: gateway-api.sigs.k8s.io 🌟
item.description: [CRITICAL] Kubernetes Gateway API represents the modern, role-oriented standard succeeding Ingress to unify edge and service mesh traffic routing.

item.title: Ray
item.description: [CRITICAL] Ray is the de facto standard distributed execution framework powering scalable cloud-native AI training and inference orchestration.

item.title: Apache Kafka
item.description: [CRITICAL] It is the de facto industry standard for distributed event streaming and real-time messaging architecture across enterprise systems.
